observed_applied_database_migration.name: 493_all_vehicle_operation_projection_guard
observed_applied_database_migration.source: Verified append-only staging-only migration chain through 493: every genuine Job Card operation is projected exactly once, and operation imports or mapping changes fail closed on any omission or duplicate.

notes: Targeted Workshop, Parts and PMB stoppage clearing is receipt-backed and exact-version protected.
RFT transport booking creates the mandatory pending salesperson payload with completed work, dates, build times, stoppages and the private QC photo reference.
Collected vehicles move to Completed, release active bay authority and remain in authoritative Completed history after refresh.
The staging-only email interceptor verifies deterministic MIME and QC attachment hashes in a private sink without external delivery.
The UID632 Stock 13000776 operational test data was removed across its exact 33-table closure after a verified encrypted full staging backup; a permanent replay fence remains.

UID635 imported Stock 13000775 as one Navision-linked canonical vehicle with OP1-OP22, seven explicit zero-hour headers, five unknown-hour headers retained as NULL, and Pre-Delivery standardised to 1.50 hours.
The isolated pmbcontroller Inbox monitor, mailbox and writer are contained after the requested one-shot import; the paused replay floor is UID636 and recurring automation was not resumed.
Dedicated Workshop planners open directly on the selected station schedule without a duplicate Back to Control Board block or cross-station tab buttons.
Stock 13000775 displays all 22 genuine Job Card operations: seven mapped internal lines, one Sublet line and fourteen unresolved lines under Unallocated – mapping review.
A database parity guard now checks every vehicle and rejects any operation import or mapping adjustment that would omit or duplicate a genuine Job Card operation in the Board/QC projection.
Linked shared Navision source rows are merged into their one active Back End Data row; current Navision colour and source salesperson are projected from the authoritative link.
All 22 UID635 operations are projected on the Board; 14 without an approved station mapping remain visible under Unallocated – mapping review rather than being omitted.
Production and real outbound email delivery remain disabled and untouched.
